S.FORM: masiin 'esi kamanʉngaku ia.
S.PHON: masiin ʔesi kamanɨŋaku ia
S.FORM: masiin 'esi kamanʉngaku ia.
S.PHON: masiin ʔesi kamanɨŋaku ia
S.TRANSL: 現在我所做的是……
What I am doing now is...

FORM.notes: source note: Uncoo意思近似於中文的「那個」。 | source note: 「種植」的詞根為mUkU。 | source note: saviki為日語借詞。 | source note: saviki老人家也會念成aviki。 | source note: umi為日語借詞(但「梅子」日語發音為ume)。

S.FORM: ʉnco nimʉka nimʉkaku ia er 'una sua saviki er umi er kanavunavu.
S.PHON: ɨnʦo nimɨka nimɨkaku ia e[r|ɾ] ʔuna sua saviki e[r|ɾ] umi e[r|ɾ] kanavunavu
S.FORM: ʉnco nimʉka nimʉkaku ia er 'una sua saviki er umi er kanavunavu.
S.PHON: ɨnʦo nimɨka nimɨkaku ia e[r|ɾ] ʔuna sua saviki e[r|ɾ] umi e[r|ɾ] kanavunavu
S.TRANSL: 我所種植的有檳榔、梅子和麻竹.
What I have grown includes betel nuts, plums, and Ma Bamboo.

S.FORM: 'una XXXX nimʉkaku masiin.
S.PHON: ʔuna **** nimɨkaku masiin
S.FORM: 'una XXXX nimʉkaku masiin.
S.PHON: ʔuna **** nimɨkaku masiin
S.TRANSL: 我現在有種植XX.
What I have grown now is XX.

FORM.notes: source note: 本IU英文直譯應為："Now the plums have already been bought (by others)."。 | source note: 「買」的詞根為pu'a。

S.FORM: er u masiin sua umi ia acecu nipu'a.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] u masiin sua umi ia aʦeʦu nipuʔa
S.FORM: er u masiin sua umi ia acecu nipu'a.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] u masiin sua umi ia aʦeʦu nipuʔa
S.TRANSL: 現在梅子已經賣掉了.
Now the plums have already been sold.

FORM.notes: source note: poti為台語借詞(布袋)。 | source note: cukue與kan都是表示不確定的用語，不把話說滿。

S.FORM: 'acecu nipu'a kan manasʉ er manasʉ urucin nʉmʉna cukue er poti.
S.PHON: ʔaʦeʦu nipuʔa kan manasɨ e[r|ɾ] manasɨ u[r|ɾ]uʦin nɨmɨna ʦukue e[r|ɾ] poti
S.FORM: 'acecu nipu'a kan manasʉ er manasʉ urucin nʉmʉna cukue er poti.
S.PHON: ʔaʦeʦu nipuʔa kan manasɨ e[r|ɾ] manasɨ u[r|ɾ]uʦin nɨmɨna ʦukue e[r|ɾ] poti
S.TRANSL: (梅子)已經賣掉了,或許有兩捆麻袋(那麼多).
(The plums), perhaps (as many as) two bundles of gunny, have already been sold.

S.FORM: sua maku.
S.PHON: sua maku
S.FORM: sua maku.
S.PHON: sua maku

S.FORM: er masiin ia 'akiacu 'esi kamanʉnga masiin sii acecu nipu'a kangvang sua er mamiriki er umi er.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] masiin ia ʔakiaʦu ʔesi kamanɨŋa masiin sii aʦeʦu nipuʔa kaŋvaŋ sua e[r|ɾ] mami[r|ɾ]iki e[r|ɾ] umi e[r|ɾ]
S.FORM: er masiin ia 'akiacu 'esi kamanʉnga masiin sii acecu nipu'a kangvang sua er mamiriki er umi er.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] masiin ia ʔakiaʦu ʔesi kamanɨŋa masiin sii aʦeʦu nipuʔa kaŋvaŋ sua e[r|ɾ] mami[r|ɾ]iki e[r|ɾ] umi e[r|ɾ]
S.TRANSL: 現在我已經沒有事做了,因為李子和梅子全都被賣掉了.
Now I already have nothing to do, because all of the plums have been sold.

FORM.notes: source note: 根據發音老師，整理麻竹，清理周遭的雜草，竹筍才長得出來。

S.FORM: tecu tecikia tia kamanʉnga masiin ia tecikia er er pocu'u kanavunavu.
S.PHON: teʦu teʦikia tia kamanɨŋa masiin ia teʦikia e[r|ɾ] e[r|ɾ] poʦuʔu kanavunavu
S.FORM: tecu tecikia tia kamanʉnga masiin ia tecikia er er pocu'u kanavunavu.
S.PHON: teʦu teʦikia tia kamanɨŋa masiin ia teʦikia e[r|ɾ] e[r|ɾ] poʦuʔu kanavunavu
S.TRANSL: 我現在要做的事是整理麻竹.
What I want to do now is clean Ma Bamboo.

FORM.notes: source note: 「竹筍」發音老師發為civu'u。

S.FORM: er pocuin kanavunavu ia manasʉ matarava sua tecu aru vuanʉ ia tecikia pocuvu'u.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] poʦuin kanavunavu ia manasɨ mata[r|ɾ]ava sua teʦu a[r|ɾ]u vuanɨ ia teʦikia poʦuvuʔu
S.FORM: er pocuin kanavunavu ia manasʉ matarava sua tecu aru vuanʉ ia tecikia pocuvu'u.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] poʦuin kanavunavu ia manasɨ mata[r|ɾ]ava sua teʦu a[r|ɾ]u vuanɨ ia teʦikia poʦuvuʔu
S.TRANSL: 整理麻竹的話,可能到八月.
If (we want to) clean Ma Bamboo, perhaps (the activity) would last until August.

S.FORM: er masuaci ia kan tia kara tekarikia.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] masuaʦi ia kan tia ka[r|ɾ]a teka[r|ɾ]ikia
S.FORM: er masuaci ia kan tia kara tekarikia.
S.PHON: e[r|ɾ] masuaʦi ia kan tia ka[r|ɾ]a teka[r|ɾ]ikia
S.TRANSL: 那樣之後,要如何,我要如何?
Being in that way, how should (I) do, how should I do?

S.FORM: tavarʉ'ʉ pocuvu'u 'aan kara marangcikia.
S.PHON: tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ poʦuvuʔu ʔaan ka[r|ɾ]a ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia
S.FORM: tavarʉ'ʉ pocuvu'u 'aan kara marangcikia.
S.PHON: tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ poʦuvuʔu ʔaan ka[r|ɾ]a ma[r|ɾ]aŋʦikia
S.TRANSL: 可以採竹筍嗎?不可以嗎?我老了.
(Am I) able to pluck the bamboo? No? I am old.

S.FORM: jiuhaole.
S.PHON: jiuhao*e
S.FORM: jiuhaole.
S.PHON: jiuhao*e
S.TRANSL: 就好了.
It is finished.
